extra.final_summary: The data had several issues affecting the analysis: (1) 'Adeile' in the 'species' column was a misspelling of 'Adelie' and was corrected using normalize_labels; (2) leading spaces in 'island' values (' Biscoe', ' Torgersen') were normalized to match allowed labels; (3) one exact duplicate row (row 22) was excluded; (4) one row (row 26) had an implausibly high body mass (4,850,000 g) outside the allowed range [2500, 6500] g and was excluded. After these fixes, the average body mass by species was calculated: Adelie: 3738.04 g, Chinstrap: 3784.38 g, Gentoo: 5105.00 g.
